notes.title: Added Play Timer!
notes.content: Added 5 minute timer for playing games. You can restart as many times as you want while the time is still going

notes.title: Update to the Timer
notes.content: You can now edit the amount of time on the timer! I understand that everyone works differently and want this tool to be as flexible for you as possible. There's a 10 minute minimum though so y'all don't just play games all day haha
